mapper.select: SELECT record_date AS date, MAX(CASE WHEN type='INCOME' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hasIncome, MAX(CASE WHEN type='EXPENSE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hasExpense, MAX(CASE WHEN type='SAVING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hasSaving, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'INCOME' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS income, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'EXPENSE' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS expense, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'SAVING' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS saving FROM service_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND record_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY record_date ORDER BY record_date

SELECT sr.id AS recordId, sr.type AS type, CASE WHEN sr.changed_category IS NOT NULL THEN sr.changed_category ELSE sr.category END AS category, sr.amount, sr.memo, u.name AS owner, sr.user_id AS ownerId, CASE WHEN sr.user_id = #{userId} THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS isMine, CASE WHEN sr.account_record_id IS NULL AND sr.card_record_id IS NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS isUserCreated FROM service_record sr INNER JOIN user u ON sr.user_id = u.id WHERE sr.user_id = #{userId} AND sr.record_date = #{date} ORDER BY sr.updated_at DESC
